info.title: Kira owner API
info.description: Owner-only API sharing the bot's handlers and knowledge. API dialogue is separate; background notifications use Telegram.

200.description: Supported formats and shared bot capability catalog
Recent API dialogue, oldest first; this is a bounded window, not a full archive
Active personal reminders from the shared registry
Up to 100 shared recurring tasks belonging to the owner

post.description: Runs the complete shared text/command flow. Retry the exact body with the same key after a connection loss. Does not cancel work when the client disconnects.

503.description: model_mode_unavailable: the app's selected mode cannot run; refused before any receipt, so the request did not execute

post.description: Invoke a signed button from the latest API turn, within 15 minutes. The same token cannot execute twice, even with a different idempotency key.

503.description: model_mode_unavailable: the app's selected mode cannot run; refused before any receipt, so the request did not execute

get.description: Download a generated file, available for 24 hours. Authorization is required.

200.description: File bytes; Content-Disposition supplies the filename

get.summary: The app's own text mode: catalog from the server preset registry with availability, this channel's selection and the global server preset

put.summary: Select a preset for this API channel only (null = as on the server). Compare-and-set on revision; applies from the next turn.

409.description: revision_conflict: the selection changed elsewhere; read it again

get.summary: AR scene capabilities: the vision route of the app's mode (browserVision), frame limits, allowed actions

200.description: Capabilities: version, frame limits, actions, autoSeat (true: sit without targetId lets the phone choose the seat; results may name it), mode, vision route

post.summary: One AR turn: a question with the scene and optionally one current JPEG frame (not stored). Kira may propose actions on ids of the scene; the phone checks and performs them and reports the outcome.

200.description: messages, actions [{id, kind: sit|stand|approach|lookAtUser, targetId?, roomId, roomVersion}] (sit without targetId: the phone chooses the seat from its own LiDAR scan), rejectedActions, vision {used, provider, model, location}

502.description: vision_failed / scene_failed / scene_reply_invalid: nothing is answered as if seen

post.summary: What actually happened to an action Kira proposed; repeating the same report is harmless

targetId.description: For a sit without targetId: the object the phone chose (servers with autoSeat)

detail.description: The steps the phone actually did (servers with autoSeat)

bearerAuth.description: Personal owner token; provision at setup, never embed in a distributed app.

Reply.description: Completed response or replayed durable receipt

Error.description: 400 invalid request; 401 unauthorized; 404 missing; 409 busy/conflict/uncertain; 410 expired action; 413 too large; 415 content type; 422 unsupported delivery; 429 rate limited; 500 internal error. Never automatically resubmit an uncertain operation using a new key.

Retry-After.description: Present for rate limiting and a busy conversation

id.description: Negative channel message ID. Upsert by ID when replaying receipts.

text.description: May be absent for markup-only edits; preserve the original text.

fileUrl.description: Relative authorized API file path or external HTTP(S) media URL. Do not forward the owner token to external URLs.

scope.description: The selection applies only to this API channel; Telegram and background work keep the server preset

runsLocally.description: Conversation runs on the server's LM Studio, not on the client

cloudFallback.description: false for provider-pure presets: no silent cross-provider fallback

Scene.description: The phone's confirmed room now: metres, Y up, ARKit world of coordinateSpaceId. Walls stay on the phone.

observedAt.description: within 120 s of the server clock
